distributionModel: shadcn-style registry — components are copied into consumer apps under components/ui/ via npx @rnui/cli add and imported through the @/ alias; there is no installed @rnui/ui runtime package

registry:components.purpose: Source of truth for all UI components — kebab-case .tsx files copied into consumer apps
useWhen: Composing app screens and features (import from '@/components/ui/<kebab>')
Adding or editing a component — edit registry/shared/ui, variants are generated
Choosing UI for a task: buttons, inputs, cards, lists, overlays, feedback
doNotUseFor: Heavy business logic (keep in app hooks/services)
Importing registry files via relative paths into packages/ — consumers use the @/ alias

registry:theme.purpose: Theme presets (neutral, stone, butter, chocolate, matcha, gothic, y2k) shipped as CSS variable files per styling variant
useWhen: Setting up theming via global.css / @theme block
Switching brand presets (npx @rnui/cli add theme-<brand>)
Looking up semantic color token names (primary, muted, destructive, ...)
doNotUseFor: Runtime theme objects or a ThemeProvider — none exists; colors resolve through CSS vars

registry:lib.purpose: Shared utilities copied with components: cn(), spacingValue(), useThemeColor(), useIconColor(), FormFieldContext
useWhen: Composing Tailwind/NativeWind classes conditionally (cn)
Reading resolved semantic colors for style-prop overrides (useThemeColor)
Icon tinting (useIconColor)
doNotUseFor: App-level utilities unrelated to registry components

@rnui/cli.purpose: CLI for the RNUI registry — init NativeWind/Uniwind setup and add components/themes to React Native apps
useWhen: Bootstrapping a consumer app (npx @rnui/cli init)
Adding components or theme presets (npx @rnui/cli add <item>)
Listing available registry items

@rnui/component-schema.purpose: Machine-readable component contracts and ScreenSchema validation for the AI builder
useWhen: Validating ScreenSchema JSON (validateScreenSchema)
Deriving lazy-load import plans (getLazyLoadPlan)
Reading per-component prop contracts, safety flags, web-preview support

@rnui/renderer.purpose: ScreenSchema renderer — validates, lazy-loads registry components, previews, and exports TSX
useWhen: Rendering a ScreenSchema at runtime (ScreenSchemaRenderer, WebPreviewHost)
Exporting schemas to TSX (exportScreenSchemaToTsx)
Building the component map for a lazy-load plan
doNotUseFor: Direct screen authoring (compose registry components by hand instead)

apps/example.purpose: Expo example app with per-component showcase screens
useWhen: Visual reference for component usage
Manual QA on device/simulator
Copying patterns for demo screens
doNotUseFor: Treating showcase screens as canonical API reference (some drift exists)

apps/web.purpose: Web builder / preview app for ScreenSchema-driven screens
useWhen: Previewing generated schemas in the browser
Developing the AI screen builder flow
doNotUseFor: Runtime app dependencies for native consumers
